hero.title: Our Story: Three Generations of Cashew Excellence in Ivory Coast
hero.subtitle: From family farm to global exporter — AfriNuts Export is redefining Ivory Coast's cashew industry through vertical integration, organic farming, and community investment.

ceo.title: A Message From Our CEO
message: At AfriNuts Export, our story begins where most agribusiness stories end — in the soil of Odienné, Côte d'Ivoire, the world's largest cashew-producing nation. I am the third generation of my family to work this land, but I came to farming through an unexpected path: software engineering.

That combination — ancestral farming wisdom and modern technology — is what makes AfriNuts different. We don't just grow cashews. We built our own farm operating system — an offline-first Android platform that tracks every tree, every block, and every expense from the field to the cloud. When a buyer asks about traceability, we don't send a spreadsheet. We show them real-time data from a farm management system we engineered ourselves.

We are building a vertically integrated cashew platform — from our 35-hectare organic farm to our future processing center. Every stage is designed for transparency: block-level tracking, digital photo documentation, harvest cycle monitoring, and financial reporting that meets institutional standards. This is not how most West African farms operate. It is how AfriNuts operates.

Our vision is clear: the cashew should not leave Africa as a raw commodity. It should reach global markets as a premium, certified product that carries the name of its origin with pride. That means investing in local processing, creating skilled jobs in Odienné, and building infrastructure that serves our community for generations.

Impact is not an afterthought — it is built into our structure. Ten percent of our net profits are reinvested into community projects: water wells, schools, and mosques. Our farmer cooperative connects 200+ local smallholders to fair pricing and technical training. This is sadaqah jariyah — ongoing charity that benefits people long after we are gone.

Our commitment to transparency is grounded in both global standards and our Islamic values. We operate on Mudarabah principles — no riba, no speculation, no hidden terms. Every investor, every buyer, every partner deserves clarity and honesty from the first conversation to the final shipment.

To our partners, customers, and investors: AfriNuts is not just another cashew supplier. We are a tech-enabled West African agribusiness platform where farming heritage, digital infrastructure, and ethical operations converge. This is an invitation to be part of something that has never been built before in this region — an African-owned, technology-driven, vertically integrated cashew value chain.
With Allah's guidance and the strength of our team, we are building more than a company. We are building a new standard for what African agriculture can achieve — from Odienné to the world.
ceo.alt: Portrait of CEO Hamza S. Ralsan Sangare
ceo.experience: Software engineer turned agribusiness founder. 5+ years leading technology-enabled agricultural operations, Farm OS development, and ethical supply chain architecture.

cfo.title: Message from Our COO
cfo.position: Co-Founder | Chief Financial & Operating Officer (CFO & COO)
message: At AfriNuts Export, our financial strategy is grounded in growth with responsibility, and innovation with integrity. Representing three generations of cashew farming, we’ve inherited more than land, we’ve inherited a legacy of trust, a commitment to our communities, and a duty to steward our resources with transparency and justice.

As CFO, I oversee a financial framework that is not solely driven by profit, but by the principle that growth must be shared. Our approach aligns with Islamic financial ethics, prioritizing profit-sharing, social impact, and long-term reinvestment in the very people and places that power our business.

We reject extractive business models. That’s why we’re transitioning from raw cashew export to in-country processing, creating jobs, building infrastructure, and adding value within Côte d’Ivoire. Every financial decision supports our broader vision: a vertically integrated cashew value chain that delivers world-class quality while uplifting local communities.

I ensure fiscal discipline, strategic investment, and complete transparency across all operations. From training farmers, to promoting sustainable agriculture, to developing a state-of-the-art processing facility in Odienné, our financial priorities serve both regional empowerment and global excellence.
AfriNuts is more than a company. We are a movement for African agricultural sovereignty, and we invite all partners who believe in a future that is as ethical as it is profitable.

farmOs.title: Built Different: Farm OS
farmOs.subtitle: Most West African farms run on paper. Ours runs on a custom-built operating system — engineered by our founder to bring institutional-grade transparency to cashew production.

offline.title: Offline-First Android App
offline.desc: Our field teams use a custom Android application that works without internet. Data syncs automatically when connectivity returns — no paper logs, no lost records.

tracking.title: Block-Level Tracking
tracking.desc: Every cashew tree is mapped to a specific block. Planting dates, survival rates, expenses, and harvest volumes are recorded per block — giving buyers full traceability.

dashboard.title: Real-Time Dashboard
dashboard.desc: Investors and managers access a live dashboard showing farm performance, financials, task management, and photo documentation — updated from the field in real time.

farmOs.techStack: Built with React, TypeScript, Firebase, and Android. Offline-first architecture with cloud synchronization. No internet? No problem.

brand.title: Our Commitment to Premium Organic Cashews from Ivory Coast
brand.text: Located in the heart of the world's largest cashew-producing nation, Côte d'Ivoire, AfriNuts Export delivers premium Ivory Coast cashews through sustainable farming and meticulous processing. We combine West Africa's agricultural heritage with international quality standards to meet growing global demand for traceable, responsibly-sourced products.

farm.title: Our 35-Hectare Organic Cashew Farm in Odienné, Ivory Coast
farm.subtitle: OUR OPERATIONS
farm.text: At the heart of Ivory Coast's cashew belt lies our family farm — 35 hectares of prime agricultural land with over 3,500 cashew trees planted. We use organic farming methods, no synthetic pesticides, and sustainable water management.
